DGをp=1/2、8/16/32セルで実行し、誤差・質量・時間積分誤差を測ります。 入力・検証手順の履歴 · 初回の入力 前提・単位・境界 全て無次元。u_t+u_x=0、区間[0,1)、周期境界、初期値0.4+sin(2πx)。解析解は0.4+sin(2π(x−t))。一定の正速度1、均一なアフィン区間要素。 採用した計算法 p+1個のGauss解点、上流数値流束、Legendre多項式によるRadau左右補正、SSPRK(3,3)。初期L2射影・上流流束・時間刻み規約をバイト一致の既存modal DGと揃えます。スケールしたCourant数(2p+1)|a|Δt/h≤.15。最後にp2/N32で刻みを半減。 Receipts cover independent ZIP extraction, tests and every fixed input within each group. Changes of settings, methods or step sizes do not add independent physical problems. 1D periodic FR advection: Radau correction and published DG comparison Transport0.4+sin(2pi x) toT=.25. Execute Gauss-node/Radau FR and the existing modal DG for p=1/2 and8/16/32 cells; measure analytic error, mass and time-integration error. Input and validation protocol history · Initial input Assumptions, units and boundaries Dimensionless u_t+u_x=0 on[0,1), periodic boundary, initial0.4+sin(2pi x), analytic0.4+sin(2pi(x-t)). Constant positive speed1 and uniform affine intervals. Adopted numerical method p+1 Gauss solution points, upwind interface flux, Legendre Radau corrections and SSPRK(3,3). Match initial L2 projection, upwind flux and timestep policy to the unchanged published modal DG. Scaled Courant(2p+1)|a|dt/h<=.15; separately halve the timestep at p2/N32. ut+aux=0,u∗(x,t)=0.4+sin⁡(2π(x−at)),a=1ut​+aux​=0,u∗​(x,t)=0.4+sin(2π(x−at)),a=1 fC=fD+(fL∗−fLD)gL+(fR∗−fRD)gR,u˙=−2h∂ξfCfC=fD+(fL∗​−fLD​)gL​+(fR∗​−fRD​)gR​,u˙=−h2​∂ξ​fC gL=(−1)p2(Pp−Pp+1),gR=12(Pp+Pp+1),ddt12∥uh∥2=−∣a∣2∑faces[uh]2gL​=2(−1)p​(Pp​−Pp+1​),gR​=21​(Pp​+Pp+1​),dtd​21​∥uh​∥2=−2∣a∣​faces∑​[uh​]2 References and measured quantities Integrate continuous L2 error at additional Gauss points and compare final polynomials with the actual published DG at common points. Check weighted mass at every RK stage and quadratic energy at each completed step. A matrix exponential of the same FR operator separately measures RK3 time error and its timestep-halving response. Verification limits and failures DG correspondence is for these Radau/Gauss choices, a constant linear flux and affine elements. No all-FR/all-DG equivalence, nonlinear flux, shock, limiter or multidimensional FR claim. Distinguish coupled h/dt refinement from the exponential spatial result; the exponential is not an independent spatial PDE solver. PyFR itself is not run.
